LESSON: THE LITTLE

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The 3.3 The good By the end of the Sub strand, the learner ● Learners to read Lu
Topic 3.4: The little

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about The little. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. state the number of baskets that remained 6 lessons keeping the environment clean
2. appreciate the miracle of the five loaves and two fish by sharing with others two fish

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. state the number of baskets that remained 6 lessons keeping the environment clean
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to state the number of baskets that remained 6 lessons keeping the environment clean. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. appreciate the miracle of the five loaves and two fish by sharing with others two fish
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the miracle of the five loaves and two fish by sharing with others two fish. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about The little.
2. Explain The little to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand The little.
4. Show that you can: state the number of baskets that remained 6 lessons keeping the environment clean
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about The little. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is The little important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. state the number of baskets that remained 6 lessons keeping the environment clean
2. appreciate the miracle of the five loaves and two fish by sharing with others two fish

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
